name: Cyber Media Research & Services Ltd.
summary: Cyber Media Research & Services Ltd. is an India-based, data-fueled, and automation-driven marketing and consulting company. The company provides AI-driven products and services focused on simplifying decision-making and driving growth for brands. Its primary services include programmatic advertising through CyberAds, advertiser solutions via CMGalaxy that cover various platform performances and lead management, and publisher monetization with AuxoAds for customer data platforms and ad operations. Additionally, it offers market research and data analytics under CyberMedia Research (CMR), delivering strategic and tactical insights, market trackers, custom data, and dashboards, as well as data-as-a-service for processing and visualizing large datasets. The company also offers consulting services such as market intelligence, market sizing, and go-to-market strategies. Cyber Media Research & Services Ltd. primarily serves clients across technology, telecom, life sciences, automotive, manufacturing, information technology, semiconductors, and other industry verticals, targeting large enterprises, small and medium businesses, and consumers globally.
